selection_policy.basis: source:real tags, source stems/families, length category and challenge/structure metadata only; no prediction outcomes or gold values
selection_policy.execution_unit: one preselected clean representative PDF per source group
selection_policy.related_member_policy: reserve all listed members to the same split; related variants are not additionally scheduled in this bounded study
selection_policy.holdout_policy: metadata only; no PDF ingestion, gold decoding/inspection or inference
selection_policy.grouping_limit: Conservative metadata-derived groups; source PDFs have stripped metadata and row format has no upstream source URL or source-family identifier. Independence is not guaranteed without provenance audit.
selection_policy.selection_kind: purposeful stratified screening sample, not random population sample
